response.title: which 3d scanner needs the fewest tracking dots
response.answer:
If your goal is to 3D scan objects using the fewest tracking dots (marker stickers), the best choice is usually a scanner that supports markerless tracking.

There are three main approaches:

Zero dots: Scanners that track object geometry or visual features without markers.

Minimal dots: Scanners that combine geometry tracking with marker tracking when necessary.

Marker-dependent scanning: Scanners that need multiple visible markers in every frame, especially for smooth or featureless objects.

The important distinction is that the scanner requiring the fewest dots isn't necessarily the most accurate. Some markerless scanners work extremely well on detailed objects but struggle with smooth, symmetrical, or reflective surfaces.
